# ALU for 32-bit MIPS
#   Inputs : a[31:0] , b[31:0] , aluc[5:0]
#   Outputs: r[31:0] , zero , carry , negative , overflow , flag

# Result of the ALU (combinational)
COMB r
  aluc=32 -> a + b                     # ADD
| aluc=33 -> a + b                     # ADDU (same arithmetic result)
| aluc=34 -> a - b                     # SUB
| aluc=35 -> a - b                     # SUBU
| aluc=36 -> a & b                     # AND
| aluc=37 -> a | b                     # OR
| aluc=38 -> a ^ b                     # XOR
| aluc=39 -> ~ (a | b)                 # NOR
| aluc=42 -> ($signed(a) < $signed(b)) ? 32'b1 : 32'b0   # SLT
| aluc=43 -> (a < b) ? 32'b1 : 32'b0                # SLTU
| aluc=0  -> b << a[4:0]               # SLL   (shift amount taken from a[4:0])
| aluc=2  -> b >> a[4:0]               # SRL
| aluc=3  -> $signed(b) >>> a[4:0]    # SRA
| aluc=4  -> b << a[4:0]               # SLLV (variable shift, same as SLL here)
| aluc=6  -> b >> a[4:0]               # SRLV
| aluc=7  -> $signed(b) >>> a[4:0]    # SRAV
| aluc=15 -> {a[15:0], 16'b0}          # LUI
| *      -> 32'b0                     # default (undefined op)

# Carry flag – meaningful for ADD/ADDU and SUB/SUBU
COMB carry
  aluc=32 | aluc=33 -> (a + b) < a      # carry out of addition
| aluc=34 | aluc=35 -> a < b          # borrow for subtraction
| *                -> 0

# Overflow flag – signed overflow for ADD/SUB
COMB overflow
  aluc=32 | aluc=33 -> (a[31]==b[31]) && (r[31]!=a[31])   # signed add overflow
| aluc=34 | aluc=35 -> (a[31]!=b[31]) && (r[31]!=a[31])   # signed sub overflow
| *                -> 0

# Zero flag – result is zero
zero = (r == 0)

# Negative flag – MSB of the result
negative = r[31]

# Flag for SLT / SLTU (the LSB of the result for those ops)
COMB flag
  aluc=42 | aluc=43 -> r[0]
| *                -> 0

```verilog
parameter SRL   = 6'b000010; // shift right logical  (shamt = a[4:0])
parameter SRA   = 6'b000011; // shift right arithmetic (shamt = a[4:0])
parameter SLLV  = 6'b000100; // shift left logical   (shamt = b[4:0])
parameter SRLV  = 6'b000110; // shift right logical  (shamt = b[4:0])
parameter SRAV  = 6'b000111; // shift right arithmetic (shamt = b[4:0])
parameter LUI   = 6'b001111; // load upper immediate
```
---
### 2. Functional description
* **Arithmetic** – `ADD`, `ADDU`, `SUB`, `SUBU`
  * `r = a + b` for ADD/ADDU, `r = a - b` for SUB/SUBU.
  * `carry` is the *carry‑out* of the addition (or the *borrow* for subtraction).

# parameter SRAV  = 6'b000111; // shift right arithmetic (shamt = b[4:0])

COMB result
  aluc=ADD   -> a + b
| aluc=ADDU  -> a + b
| aluc=SUB   -> a - b
| aluc=SUBU  -> a - b
| aluc=AND   -> a & b
| aluc=OR    -> a | b
| aluc=XOR   -> a ^ b
| aluc=NOR   -> ~(a | b)
| aluc=SLT   -> ((a[31]==b[31]) ? (a<b) : a[31]) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0
| aluc=SLTU  -> (a < b) ? 32'd1 : 32'd0
| aluc=SLL   -> b << a[4:0]
| aluc=SRL   -> b >> a[4:0]
| aluc=SRA   -> b >>> a[4:0]
| aluc=SLLV  -> a << b[4:0]
| aluc=SRLV  -> a >> b[4:0]
| aluc=SRAV  -> a >>> b[4:0]
| aluc=LUI   -> {b[15:0], 16'b0}
| *          -> 32'b0

# Carry flag (carry‑out for add, borrow for sub)
COMB carry
  aluc=ADD   -> ((a + b) < a)
| aluc=ADDU  -> ((a + b) < a)
| aluc=SUB   -> (a < b)
| aluc=SUBU  -> (a < b)
| *          -> 0

# Overflow flag (signed overflow only for signed add/sub)
COMB overflow
  aluc=ADD   -> ((~a[31] & ~b[31] & result[31]) | (a[31] & b[31] & ~result[31]))
| aluc=ADDU  -> 0
| aluc=SUB   -> ((a[31] & ~b[31] & ~result[31]) | (~a[31] & b[31] & result[31]))
| aluc=SUBU  -> 0
| *          -> 0

COMB flag
  aluc=SLT   -> 1
| aluc=SLTU  -> 1
| *          -> 0

assign zero = (result == 32'b0);
assign negative = result[31];
assign carry = carry;
assign overflow = overflow;

  opn_valid & ~res_valid -> dividend

  opn_valid & ~res_valid -> divisor
  * -> divisor_reg

  opn_valid & ~res_valid -> sign
  * -> sign_reg

| * -> dividend_reg

  sign_reg & divisor_reg[7] -> (~divisor_reg + 1)
| * -> divisor_reg

REG start_cnt @clk.pos reset.sync->0
  opn_valid & ~res_valid -> 1
| start_cnt & cnt[3] -> 0
| * -> start_cnt

REG cnt[4] @clk.pos reset.sync->0
  start_cnt -> 1
| start_cnt & ~cnt[3] -> cnt + 1
| start_cnt & cnt[3] -> 0
| * -> cnt

REG remainder[8] @clk.pos reset.sync->0
  opn_valid & ~res_valid -> dividend_abs
| start_cnt & ~cnt[3] & (remainder - divisor_abs >= 0) -> (remainder - divisor_abs)
| * -> remainder

| start_cnt & ~cnt[3] & (remainder - divisor_abs >= 0) -> {quotient[6:0],1'b1}

| res_ready -> 0
| * -> res_valid

| * -> quotient

| * -> remainder

// Non‑restoring radix‑2 divider, 8‑bit, signed/unsigned, handshaked
STATES: IDLE=0, BUSY=1

REG state[1] @clk.pos reset.sync->IDLE NEXT=next_state
COMB next_state
  state=IDLE & opn_valid & ~res_valid -> BUSY
| state=BUSY & cnt=8 -> IDLE
| * -> state

REG cnt[4] @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_cnt
COMB next_cnt
  state=IDLE -> 0
| state=BUSY -> cnt+1
| * -> cnt

REG res_valid @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_res_valid
COMB next_res_valid
  state=BUSY & cnt=8 -> 1
| res_valid & res_ready -> 0
| * -> res_valid

REG dividend_reg[8] @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_dividend_reg
COMB next_dividend_reg
  state=IDLE & opn_valid & ~res_valid -> dividend
| * -> dividend_reg

REG divisor_reg[8] @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_divisor_reg
COMB next_divisor_reg
  state=IDLE & opn_valid & ~res_valid -> divisor
| * -> divisor_reg

REG sign_reg @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_sign_reg
COMB next_sign_reg
  state=IDLE & opn_valid & ~res_valid -> sign
| * -> sign_reg

// sign flags for the latched operands
dividend_negative = dividend_reg[7] & sign_reg
divisor_negative  = divisor_reg[7]  & sign_reg

// absolute values (unsigned representation used by the algorithm)
abs_dividend = dividend_negative=1 ? (~dividend_reg+1) : dividend_reg
abs_divisor  = divisor_negative=1  ? (~divisor_reg+1)  : divisor_reg

// negative divisor used for subtraction (two's‑complement)
NEG_DIVISOR = (~abs_divisor)+1

// preload value for the shift register
sr_load = ({abs_dividend,8'b0}) << 1

REG SR[16] @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_SR
COMB next_SR
  state=IDLE & opn_valid & ~res_valid -> sr_load
| state=BUSY -> ({upper_next, (SR)[7:0], qbit})[15:0]
| * -> SR

// intermediate combinational helpers for the non‑restoring step
temp = ((SR)[15:8]) + NEG_DIVISOR
qbit = (temp)[8]=0 ? 1 : 0
upper_next = (temp)[8]=0 ? (temp)[7:0] : (SR)[15:8]

// final quotient/remainder before signed correction
quotient_unsigned = (SR)[7:0]
remainder_unsigned = (SR)[15:8]

// flags that tell whether sign correction is needed
quot_neg = dividend_negative ^ divisor_negative
rem_neg  = dividend_negative

final_quot = sign_reg=1 & quot_neg=1 ? (~quotient_unsigned+1) : quotient_unsigned
final_rem  = sign_reg=1 & rem_neg=1  ? (~remainder_unsigned+1) : remainder_unsigned

REG result[16] @clk.pos reset.sync->0 NEXT=next_result
COMB next_result
  state=BUSY & cnt=8 -> {final_rem, final_quot}
| * -> result

# Radix-2 (non-restoring) 8-bit divider with signed/unsigned support
# Implements handshake, synchronous reset, and divisor‑zero stall

# Start condition: new operation accepted when opn_valid high, result not yet valid, divisor non‑zero
COMB start
  opn_valid=1 & res_valid=0 & divisor!=0 -> 1
| * -> 0

# Latch inputs on start
REG dividend_l[8] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> dividend
| * -> dividend_l

REG divisor_l[8] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> divisor
| * -> divisor_l

REG sign_l @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> sign
| * -> sign_l

# Determine original sign bits (only relevant when sign==1)
COMB dividend_neg
  sign_l=1 & dividend_l[7]=1 -> 1
| * -> 0

COMB divisor_neg
  sign_l=1 & divisor_l[7]=1 -> 1
| * -> 0

# Absolute values of operands
COMB abs_dividend
  sign_l=1 & dividend_l[7]=1 -> (~dividend_l + 1)
| * -> dividend_l

COMB abs_divisor
  sign_l=1 & divisor_l[7]=1 -> (~divisor_l + 1)
| * -> divisor_l

# NEG_DIVISOR = -abs_divisor (two's complement)
REG NEG_DIVISOR[8] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> (~abs_divisor + 1)
| * -> NEG_DIVISOR

# Counter (1‑based, runs 1..8). Clears to 0 on reset or after completion.
REG cnt[4] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> 1
| busy=1 & cnt<8 -> cnt + 1
| * -> 0

# Busy flag: high while cnt ≠ 0
REG busy @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> 1
| cnt=8 -> 0
| * -> busy

# Shift register SR holds {remainder,quotient} during the algorithm
REG SR[16] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  start=1 -> ({abs_dividend,8'b0} << 1)
| busy=1 -> ( { ( ((SR[15:8] + NEG_DIVISOR)[8]) ? (SR[15:8] + NEG_DIVISOR)[7:0] : SR[15:8] ) , SR[7:0] } << 1 ) | ( (SR[15:8] + NEG_DIVISOR)[8] )
| * -> SR

# Final quotient after sign correction
REG final_q[8] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  cnt=8 -> ( sign_l=1 & dividend_neg!=divisor_neg ) ? (~SR[7:0] + 1) : SR[7:0]
| * -> final_q

# Final remainder after sign correction
REG final_r[8] @clk.pos rst.sync->0
  cnt=8 -> ( sign_l=1 & dividend_neg ) ? (~SR[15:8] + 1) : SR[15:8]
| * -> final_r

# Output result register (port)
REG result[16] @clk.pos rst.sync->0 PORT
  cnt=8 -> {final_r, final_q}
| * -> result

# Output valid flag (port)
REG res_valid @clk.pos rst.sync->0 PORT
  cnt=8 -> 1
| res_valid=1 & res_ready=1 -> 0
| * -> res_valid

# 64-bit pipelined ripple‑carry adder (4×16‑bit stages)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameter‑derived constants (used only for readability – the parser
# treats them as comments).  DATA_WIDTH = 64, STG_WIDTH = 16, NUM_STG = 4.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Pipeline enable shift‑register (4‑bit vector).  LSB is the enable for
# stage 0, MSB for stage 3.  Synchronous reset is active‑low (rst_n).
REG en_pipe[4] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  * -> {en_pipe[3:1], i_en}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 0 (bits 15:0)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
REG sum0[16] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[0]=1 -> (adda[15:0] + addb[15:0])
  | *          -> sum0

REG carry1[1] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[0]=1 -> ((adda[15:0] + addb[15:0]) >> 16)
  | *          -> carry1

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 1 (bits 31:16)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
REG sum1[16] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[1]=1 -> (adda[31:16] + addb[31:16] + carry1)
  | *          -> sum1

REG carry2[1] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[1]=1 -> ((adda[31:16] + addb[31:16] + carry1) >> 16)
  | *          -> carry2

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 2 (bits 47:32)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
REG sum2[16] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[2]=1 -> (adda[47:32] + addb[47:32] + carry2)
  | *          -> sum2

REG carry3[1] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[2]=1 -> ((acca[47:32] + addb[47:32] + carry2) >> 16)
  | *          -> carry3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 3 (bits 63:48) – produces the final carry (bit 64)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
REG sum3[16] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[3]=1 -> (adda[63:48] + addb[63:48] + carry3)
  | *          -> sum3

REG carry4[1] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0
  en_pipe[3]=1 -> ((adda[63:48] + addb[63:48] + carry3) >> 16)
  | *          -> carry4

# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Assemble the final 65‑bit result when the last stage finishes.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------
REG result[65] @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0 PORT
  en_pipe[3]=1 -> {carry4, sum3, sum2, sum1, sum0}
  | *          -> result

# Output‑enable – high for one cycle when the result becomes valid.
REG o_en @clk.pos rst_n.syncneg->0 PORT
  en_pipe[3]=1 -> 1
  | *          -> 0

  * -> en_pipe[NUM_STAGES-1]

  | *          -> sum0

  en_pipe[0]=1 -> (temp0)[STG_WIDTH]
  | *          -> carry0
